investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC investigation per BOTM-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01: one unauthenticated GET to the venue's official_website (WebFetch/curl fallback), with at most one additional same-origin GET when official_programme_url was directly supplied as a candidate field. No browser, authentication, CAPTCHA bypass, or retry loop.

identity.notes: Canonical URL and og:url both resolve to the same domain as the supplied official_website, and <title>/og:site_name match the venue name exactly; no cross-domain redirect occurred.

site_classification.platform: Wix single-page application — the fetched HTML contains only <head> metadata and client-side JS bootstrap code; no server-rendered body content was present in this GET.

venue_location.notes: Discovery evidence (candidate record) reports 'Marylebone Road 134, London'; this passive probe did not independently confirm an address on the page and does not promote this to a canonical venue fact.

blockers.description: Client-rendered Wix SPA: no event/programme listing, JSON-LD, ICS feed, or discoverable JSON API endpoint was present in the static HTML response.

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated GET to the official homepage returned only <head> metadata (confirming music identity) and Wix client-side bootstrap code; no visible event/programme data or discoverable data path was exposed.

reasons: The fetched <head> metadata (<title>, meta description 'Live Music Venue | Arabic & Middle Eastern Nightclub London', og tags, canonical URL) genuinely confirms this is a live-music venue, satisfying BeatMapped's venue-level music gate on real evidence.
The site is a Wix single-page application; the bounded GET exposed no event listing, JSON-LD, ICS feed, or discoverable first-party JSON API for individual events.
No first-party acquisition path could be established from this single Level-1 GET; Level 2/3 structural or browser work would be required, which is out of scope for this bounded pass.

evidence.description: Verbatim, byte-faithful <head> excerpt from a single unauthenticated GET of the official homepage: <title>, meta description, and canonical link, confirming venue identity and self-described live-music/nightclub programming.
evidence.method: curl -sS -L; descriptive User-Agent; single unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; no retry
